QA Analyst
 Location: Remote (Southern Europe / North Africa) 
 Work model: Fully remote 
 Team: MOVION
 About Movion
 Movion helps digital brands reach and grow audiences through mobile networks around the world. We bring together performance marketing, technology, content, and local payment solutions to turn great digital products into successful subscription businesses.
 With more than 16 years of mobile expertise and activity in over 45 markets, we work across everything from user acquisition and creative campaigns to payment integrations and revenue optimisation. We also build and distribute our own digital products in gaming, fitness, learning, sports, and entertainment.
 At Movion, you’ll join an international, collaborative team where you can take ownership, learn from people across disciplines, and see the impact of your work.
 The role
 For our growing MOVION product team, we're looking for a QA Analyst. Your mission is to make sure quality assurance is seamlessly integrated throughout the software development lifecycle from initial design to final release.
 You'll collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to uphold high standards of quality and deliver an outstanding customer experience. Your role involves planning and executing tests, promoting best practices, and contributing to the continuous improvement of our product.
 Job Responsibilities

• Perform manual testing of multilingual portals and landing pages across various devices to ensure consistent functionality and user experience.

• Validate integrations with payment partners in both staging and production environments.

• Utilize tools like BrowserStack and other testing platforms to simulate real-world scenarios and environments.

• Review software requirements and translate them into clear, actionable test scenarios.

• Document and report test results, including any defects or inconsistencies, in a structured and timely manner.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand product requirements and align testing efforts with business goals.

• Participate in design and requirement reviews, offering insights on potential risks, usability concerns, and quality improvements.

 Job Requirements

• Minimum of 1 year of experience in software testing or quality assurance.

• Solid understanding of software test design and testing methodologies.

• Familiarity with various testing techniques and compatibility across different software platforms.

• Strong ability to clearly describe unexpected or incorrect system behavior.

• Basic working knowledge of programming concepts.

• Understanding of browser development tools for debugging and analysis.

• Excellent communication and critical thinking skills.

• Well-organized, responsible, and detail-oriented with a proactive mindset.

 What We Offer

• A fast-growing, international environment with 25+ nationalities.

• Competitive salary for the region. Approx 1,500 - 2,000 euros

• Fully remote work with flexible collaboration across time zones.

• Learning opportunities to grow your QA and cross-departmental knowledge.

• A young, ambitious team and a culture that values ownership, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

 Movion is proud to be a diverse and equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any characteristic protected by law. Decisions are based solely on job-related factors.
